Elizabeth Holmes to move to halfway house

Elizabeth Holmes, founder of the defunct blood-testing company Theranos, is scheduled to be transferred to a halfway house in August 2027. She was sentenced to 11 years in prison in 2022. Her sentence has been reduced multiple times.
